title: Cosmic Serpent Sorceress
description: A vibrant green serpentine female figure with long pink and purple braided hair wears a purple mask while holding a large stylized cosmic eye containing a galaxy and glowing orb. Two grey aliens stand to the left observing. The dark background features dripping colorful paint, hanging flowers, lightning, and a starry nebula.
